provenance.caen_revision: CAEN Rev.2, as filed for the year
provenance.citation: Ministerul Finantelor - situatii financiare anuale, published on data.gov.ro, FY2024, CC-BY-4.0

method.arithmetic: decimal, precision 28, round half even; fractions to 6 places, days to 2
method.invalid_rows: the strict reader aborts the build on any malformed row; none are skipped quietly
method.natural_person_forms: absent by construction: families UU and BL are 'societati comerciale' per the portal's description file; any other family is refused
method.peer_set: every filer in families UU and BL with a positive filed net turnover (I13) in the sector for the year; the subject company, if it filed there, is included
method.per_ratio_drop: a row with an absent operand or a non-positive denominator is dropped from that ratio only and counted; nothing is imputed, an empty field is never zero
method.total_assets: I1 + I2 + I6, all three required

equity_ratio.company_basis: total equity / total assets; same definition as the ratio card

inventory_days_on_turnover.company_basis: inventory / NET TURNOVER x 365. The ratio card's DIO divides by operating cost; the two are not comparable. Restate the company figure on turnover or refuse the comparison

liabilities_to_assets.company_basis: TOTAL liabilities (datorii) / total assets. Deferred income (I8) and provisions (I9) sit outside I7. This is NOT the ratio card's debt / assets, which reads financial debt only

net_margin.company_basis: net result / net turnover; same definition as the ratio card

receivables_days.company_basis: ALL receivables (creante) / net turnover x 365, not trade receivables only

revenue_growth.company_basis: net turnover growth year on year
revenue_growth.formula: I13 (year) / I13 (prior year) - 1, joined by CUI, prior I13 > 0

roe.company_basis: net result / YEAR-END equity. The ratio card uses average equity when a prior period exists; the company figure must be restated on year-end equity before it is set beside this band

cash_ratio.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish current liabilities

ccc.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish trade payables or cost of goods sold

current_ratio.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish current liabilities (I7 is total liabilities)

debt_to_assets.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish financial debt; see liabilities_to_assets

debt_to_equity.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish financial debt (I7 is total liabilities)

dio.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish operating cost; see inventory_days_on_turnover

dpo.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish trade payables or cost of goods sold

dscr.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish interest expense or debt service

ebit_margin.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish operating result

ebitda_margin.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish operating result or depreciation

gross_margin.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish cost of goods sold

interest_coverage.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish interest expense

net_debt_ebitda.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish financial debt or EBITDA

quick_ratio.reason: the summary-level filing does not publish current liabilities
